known_findings.summary: In-tree Annoy import catches Exception and silently falls back to external annoy, which can mask defects in the owned backend boundary.
_ann.py imports pandas at module scope but has no runtime pd usage; the tests themselves treat pandas as optional.

_base.py is a large sklearn-derived mirror, but __init__.py/_ann.py use sklearn directly and test__base/test_common exercise sklearn rather than this local mirror. Its active role is ambiguous and drift is not detected by the runtime suite.
